name: How much does it cost to renovate a rental kitchen or bathroom?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to renovate a rental kitchen or bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of renovating a rental kitchen or bathroom varies widely based on material choices, fixture quality, and the extent of the remodel. Basic refreshes might start around $8,000 for a bathroom and $15,000 for a kitchen, while mid-range remodels can range from $15,000-$30,000+ for bathrooms and $25,000-$50,000+ for kitchens. We provide detailed estimates tailored to your budget and goals.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for kitchen and bathroom renovations vary by scope and materials, typically ranging from $8,000 to over $50,000.
